card.name: Duration words in all-caps warnings
card.fires_on: Time-span words in ALL-CAPS boxed warnings, such as the numbers in "within 2 to 3 weeks" and "prolonged" or "longer" before "periods". Also fires on "see" before a section name like WARNINGS.

modes.label: Time span numbers
modes.description: Numbers giving a number of weeks in capitalized warning text.
modes.example: IF A PATIENT DEVELOPS ANEMIA ANYTIME WITHIN <<2>> TO 3 WEEKS SUBSEQUENT

modes.label: Prolonged or longer
modes.description: Parts of words meaning long duration of use, before periods or term.
modes.example: ADMINISTRATION OF AMPHETAMINES FOR PROLONG<<ED>> PERIODS OF TIME MAY LEAD

modes.label: See section reference
modes.description: The word see or also in a pointer to a labeled section.
modes.example: the patient should be instructed to notify the physician immediately if they occur (see<< also>> PRECAUTIONS ).

card.plain: It lights up on how long something lasts in capitalized warning text, like weeks of treatment or prolonged use.
